Provident Estate is pleased to offer you this One Bedroom apartment for Rent at Al Serh Residences 11 By Asak, Jumeirah Village Circle (JVC), Dubai.

-One Bedroom
-Two Bathrooms
-868 Sq. ft.
-Low floor
-Fully Furnished (Brand New)
-Newly Built
-Vacant Ready to Move In
-Flexible Cheques
-Bills Included Option Available
-Dedecated Parking Spot
-Shared Gym and Pool

Project Features:


  Al Serh Residences is a building in Jumeirah Village Circle (JVC) Dubai, offering modern apartments with practical layouts and everyday comfort. Residents benefit from amenities such as a gym, pool, and nearby retail and dining options. It’s ideal for users seeking convenient living in a well-connected community.


About the Community:

Jumeirah Village Circle (JVC) is a master community offering a mix of apartments, townhouses, and villas within landscaped surroundings. It features schools, supermarkets, parks, gyms, and dining options, making it family-friendly and convenient. With direct access to Al Khail Road and Sheikh Mohammed bin Zayed Road, JVC provides easy connectivity across Dubai.

Proximity :
It’s only 10 minutes drive to The Dubai Hills Mall , 20 Minutes to Jumeirah Beach and 15 minutes to The Mall Of Emirates so you don’t have to worry as you are close to all the Dubai iconic destinations!
